answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in reef, verified in island, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the inlet check. A farm of 3644 identities would post 1626 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
